label: Marketing performance review
description: Propose a performance review / learnings brief from analytics or ads report content (GA4, GSC, Meta insights)

description_i18n.en: Propose a performance review / learnings brief from analytics or ads report content
description_i18n.zh_CN: 根据分析或广告报告内容提出表现复盘/学习要点
description_i18n.zh_HK: 根據分析或廣告報告內容提出表現複盤/學習要點

propose_guide: Use after google/analytics-report, google/search-console, or meta/ads-insights when NL asks what worked, what to change, or a weekly marketing review. Take upstream report `content` as `report`. Emit Internal sections: wins, lags, hypotheses, next experiments, recommended connector actions — do not change ads bids or send mail in this skill.

propose_guide_i18n.en: After GA4/GSC/Meta insights when NL asks what worked. Emit Internal wins/lags/next experiments — do not mutate ads.
propose_guide_i18n.zh_CN: 在 GA4/GSC/Meta 洞察之后，用户问效果如何时使用。产出内部得失与下一步——不改广告。
propose_guide_i18n.zh_HK: 在 GA4/GSC/Meta 洞察之後，用戶問效果如何時使用。產出內部得失與下一步——不改廣告。

params.name: report
params.propose_hint: Pass google/analytics-report, google/search-console, or meta/ads-insights content as `report`.

params.name: goal
params.description: Campaign goal for scoring the period
params.example_nl: Review last week's GA4 and Search Console for the launch
